description: An oil-style painting of a large outdoor crowd on an open grassy field under a grey, cloudy sky. Men in top hats, caps and waistcoats press around a wooden cart carrying a huge rolled sheet of paper covered in scribbled handwriting, with several men in dark frock coats standing on or beside it, one gesturing. Red, green and white flags rise above the crowd. Behind them, factory chimneys smoke and a church spire rises over a town skyline.
